[[File:Portrait torvald.jpg|140px|left|link=House Stonebear]]
'''[[House Stonebear]]''' holds that a word is the only stone that holds. The realm's oath-witnesses and judges, admired by all, exploited by many, seldom loved — a house being slowly bankrupted by its own kept word, led by [[Reverend Torvald]], a man entirely at peace with the cost.
